scope: Owner-authorized read-only Metrika daily, weekly and monthly reports to the existing LOOP lead channel; no Direct integration.

schedule.daily: 10:00 Europe/Moscow; yesterday versus same weekday last week
schedule.weekly: Monday 10:00 Europe/Moscow; complete Monday-Sunday versus preceding week
schedule.monthly: Day 1 10:00 Europe/Moscow; complete preceding calendar month versus previous complete month
schedule.retry: Every 30 minutes for due unacknowledged periods

local.staged_secret_review: passed; no tokens, real aggregates or private message links

api.qa_filters: current source qa/release_check/metrika_check and medium qa/test excluded
api.live_previous_day_ui_comparison: users, visits, source breakdown matched using equivalent UI filters
api.monthly_live_range: historical complete months; upcoming period covered by calendar tests

delivery.display: verified visually and via accessibility in the existing lead channel
delivery.regular_repeat_run: success; durable sent state unchanged, no extra messages
delivery.exactly_once: not guaranteed after lost webhook acknowledgement

not_applicable: No page/visual change: five-width layout checks, new SEO/robots/sitemap/index submission
No lead intake change or credentials: synthetic customer submission, database/file/mail-chain tests
No frontend counter or SDK change: repeat reachGoal/Webvisor validation
Static ops/deploy.sh: no static release; independent reporter installer used
limitations: Future daily, weekly and monthly scheduled dispatches have not yet occurred.
Periods starting before 2026-09-14 have incomplete tracking history; growth percentages are suppressed.
Metrika can hide details for small samples. Unlabelled QA visits may remain.
Goal completions are not verified commercial leads or paid orders; no database reconciliation or Direct costs.
Late Metrika processing may revise aggregate results.
Webhook acknowledgement loss can produce duplicate reports bearing the same period key.
Reporter failures produce neutral journal codes and retries; no separate failure alerts added.
privacy: Actual traffic counts, OAuth credentials, webhook URL, lead content and private message links are omitted.
